title: Pork and Ukrainian Dumplings
description: A hearty Ukrainian-inspired dish featuring pork and homemade dumplings.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine pork, nutty, egg, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, combine all-purpose flour and soft flour. Mix well.
Gradually add the flour mixture to the pork mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes and let rest for 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into small pieces and roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of water in the center of each circle and fold the dough over to form a dumpling.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve the dumplings with your favorite Ukrainian-inspired sauce.
